meta.description: Runs Gene Ontology over-representation analysis for a selected gene list using clusterProfiler enrichGO, with explicit background-universe selection, ID conversion, GO-DAG redundancy handling, custom TERM2GENE enrichment, and an optional GOseq length-bias route.
meta.environment: Isolated WSL prefix /home/sci/openscience-go-audit-20260923; R 4.4.3; Bioconductor 3.20; clusterProfiler 4.14.0; org.Hs.eg.db 3.20.0; GOSemSim 2.32.0; goseq 1.58.0; GenomicFeatures 1.58.0; TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene 3.20.0. The shared Windows environment was not changed.
meta.audit_type: Phase 2 final-pass re-audit of the exact pushed corrective tip. The superseded 5ed09f report, viewer, data, and run material were archived under F:\OpenScience\audits\_pre-fix-20260923\bio-pathway-go-enrichment\tip-5ed09f789aed05537c7899553ac6ebc005fe7e93.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All claims and numeric outcomes in the exercised routes came from local package output; no fabricated studies, identifiers, or biomedical results were generated.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill performs research enrichment analysis and explicitly frames output as hypotheses, not clinical diagnosis or treatment advice.

methodological_ground.detail: Executed routes used an explicit tested-gene universe, BH adjustment, ontology-aware redundancy reduction, and the stated Wallenius length-bias correction.

code_usability.detail: Both shipped examples, ORA variants, custom enricher, and the literal corrected GOseq block executed in the recorded isolated runtime.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensively covers matched-universe GO ORA, ID conversion, redundancy, custom sets, and RNA-seq length bias; the top compatibility statement conflicts with the verified Bioconductor 3.20 route.

reliability.note: Clear failure modes and the new GOseq preflight detect package, identifier, length, and GO-coverage problems; other-organism users must provide their own matched local annotation inputs.

performance_context.note: The workflow is direct and offline at runtime, although deriving exon-union lengths across the full TxDb is intentionally expensive and uncached.

agent_usability.note: Decision fork, explicit arguments, checks, and error guidance are clear; tested-version wording should agree with the pinned install release.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language, concise usage prompts, and explicit interpretation cautions support correct handoff to an agent.

security.note: No secrets, destructive commands, or raw code execution are present; normal user-provided file tables still rely on the surrounding analysis environment for access control.

maintainability.note: Sections, examples, references, and local-package interfaces are clear; the 43-line GOseq fence is a substantial inline executable block rather than a reusable parameterized script.

agent_specific.note: Trigger and routing are precise, scope boundaries point to GSEA and sibling pathway Skills, and the workflow has useful stops and fallbacks.

key_strengths: All seven re-audit inputs executed with saved runners and checked outputs.
The corrected hg38 GOseq route is locally versioned, guarded, and executed literally without a UCSC or geneLenDataBase hg38 lookup.
Both shipped examples are self-contained and passed unchanged, including per-ontology redundancy reduction.
The Skill consistently requires an explicit tested-gene universe and distinguishes ORA, groupGO, custom enrichment, and ranked GSEA scope.

recommendations.title: Reconcile the compatibility statements
recommendations.problem: The top compatibility block claims reference examples were tested with clusterProfiler 4.18.4+ and org.Hs.eg.db 3.22+, while the new hg38 GOseq route and usage guide explicitly pin Bioconductor 3.20 and were verified here with clusterProfiler 4.14.0 and org.Hs.eg.db 3.20.0.
recommendations.root_cause: The older global version note was not updated when the executable Bioconductor 3.20 GOseq route was added.
recommendations.fix: Replace the global tested-version claim with the verified Bioconductor 3.20 package set, or clearly separate the independently verified version sets and state which blocks each applies to.

recommendations.title: Extract the long GOseq recipe into a script
recommendations.problem: The corrected executable GOseq recipe is now a 43-line inline fence, making reuse, parameterization, and independent testing less convenient.
recommendations.root_cause: The necessary corrective checks and local annotation construction expanded a formerly short illustration in place.
recommendations.fix: Move the complete hg38 recipe to a parameterized scripts/goseq_hg38.R file with a short invocation in SKILL.md, preserving the literal preflight and local bias-data route.
